title: Model magic item activated forms, devices, zones and apparatus state (M5)
description: Implement family M5 from docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-7-3-magic-item-mechanics-inventory.md §4: 50 rows (exact membership = §2 rows tagged M5). Sub-shapes: on/off toggles (flame-tongue, sun-blade, invisibility, hoods), animated objects with object stats (dancing-sword, animated-shield, ropes incl. self-repair), vehicles/structures (apparatus-of-the-crab, broom, carpet, folding-boat, instant-fortress), barriers/zones (cube-of-force faces, bead-of-force sphere, eversmoking-bottle growth, auras, insect cloud), restraints with escape state and lockouts (iron-bands, dimensional-shackles, rope-of-entanglement), form machines (rod-of-lordly-might six buttons), orbit state (ioun), progressive unlocks (ring-of-elemental-command), sphere-of-annihilation (flagship: control/contest/movement math). Hardest family; design a shared activation/duration/termination contract first, then per-item state machines. Distinguish pack data from live session state (durable item-state lives with the inventory row properties_json or a dedicated owner - design decision). Recommended agent: Opus 4.8.
notes:
2026-07-08 ADR 0017 adjustment: For activated forms/devices/zones, design pack-side operation/state-machine contracts and hook requirements first. Mutable per-instance apparatus/form/zone state belongs in live item/encounter state owned by runtime services; generated records carry immutable source-derived semantics only.
Implemented the source-grounded family projector, strict schema validation, clause registry bindings, generated pack projection, and representative/exhaustive tests. The exact 240-row owner-tag conservation census passes; all magic items now carry reviewed executable mechanics.
close_reason: Source-faithful executable magic-item family complete; canonical regeneration, conservation gates, deep audit, and full worktree verification pass.
